trace.final:
All done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosed the failure:** The latest deploy, checkout-api **v2.3.1**, was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Release history showed the most recent release that was **healthy in production** was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back:** Executed a rollback of checkout-api to **v2.3.0** across all production regions.
3. **Verified recovery:** Post-rollback status confirms the service is now **healthy** with the error rate down to **0.2%**.
4. **Opened a SEV2 incident:** Created **INC-0001** ("checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer and documents the mitigation.

Note: v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging, so any attempt to redeploy v2.3.1 should wait for a root-cause investigation (and, per policy, change-manager approval since it has never been healthy in production).
